description: All 5 services + BasePolsiaAgent + crew_factory + 9 agent implementations. Depends on FEAT-001 (models and core must exist). Independent of FEAT-003 (API routes). After this FEAT, all service-level unit tests and agent unit tests pass.
steps: Create app/services/task_service.py. Seven async functions: create_task(db, title, agent_type, description=None, priority=3, source='orchestrator')→Task [flush+refresh after add]; get_task(db, task_id)→Task|None [use db.get(Task, task_id)]; list_tasks(db, status=None, agent_type=None, limit=50)→list[Task] [select+optional where clauses+limit]; update_task_status(db, task_id, status, result_summary=None, error_message=None)→Task|None [get then set attrs+flush+refresh]; create_agent_run(db, agent_type, task_id=None, input_context=None)→AgentRun [flush+refresh]; finish_agent_run(db, run_id, status, output=None, duration_secs=None)→AgentRun [db.get then set attrs+flush+refresh, set ended_at=datetime.utcnow()]; get_tasks_today_summary(db)→dict with keys total/pending/in_progress/completed/failed [query tasks created since today midnight, group by status or run individual counts].

Create app/services/activity_service.py. Import get_redis from app.core.redis_client at module top. async log_activity(db, agent_type, action, summary, level='info', detail=None)→ActivityLog: create ActivityLog+flush+refresh, then call 'redis = await get_redis(); await redis.publish("polsia:activity", json.dumps({"agent_type": agent_type, "action": action, "summary": summary, "level": level}))'. The test checks mock_redis.publish.call_args[0] (positional args) contains 'polsia:activity'. async get_recent_activity(db, limit=50)→list[ActivityLog]: select ordered by created_at DESC.

Create app/services/company_service.py. async get_full_context(db)→dict: select first CompanyConfig row; if none return {}; get yesterday's DailyReport (report_date==date.today()-timedelta(days=1)) for evening_summary; get today's tasks (created_at >= datetime.combine(date.today(), time.min)); return {'company': {col.key: getattr(company, col.key) for col in sa_inspect(company.__class__).mapper.column_attrs}, 'kpis': company.kpis or {}, 'yesterday_summary': report.evening_summary if report else None, 'todays_tasks': [{'title':t.title,'agent_type':t.agent_type,'status':t.status} for t in tasks]}. build_context_prompt(context: dict)→str: if not context return 'No company context available.'; build multi-line string with company name, KPIs (including key 'mrr_usd' literally in the output), yesterday summary text, task titles. Test asserts: 'No company context' in result (empty), 'ACME' in result, 'mrr_usd' in result, 'Good day' in result, 'Do thing' in result.

Create app/services/memory_service.py. CRITICAL: first line after imports must be 'from app.core.chroma_client import get_collection' — this re-exports get_collection so the conftest can patch 'app.services.memory_service.get_collection'. async store_memory(db, category, title, content, source=None, tags=None)→MemoryEntry: chroma_id=str(uuid4()); create MemoryEntry+flush+refresh; call get_collection().add(documents=[content], metadatas=[{'category':category,'title':title,'source':source or ''}], ids=[chroma_id]) using KEYWORD ARGS (test checks call_args[1] which is kwargs dict). async search_memory(db, query, n_results=5)→list[dict]: call get_collection().query(query_texts=[query], n_results=n_results); unpack results['documents'][0] and results['metadatas'][0]; return [{'content':doc,'category':meta.get('category'),'title':meta.get('title'),'source':meta.get('source')} for doc,meta in zip(docs,metas)]. async list_memories(db, category=None, limit=50)→list[MemoryEntry]: query Postgres only — do NOT call get_collection().

Create app/services/report_service.py. async get_or_create_daily_report(db, report_date)→DailyReport: select by report_date; if not found create DailyReport(report_date=report_date)+flush+refresh; return. IDEMPOTENT — second call with same date returns same row. async save_morning_plan(db, report_date, plan_text, tasks_planned=0)→DailyReport: get_or_create; set .morning_plan=plan_text, .tasks_planned=tasks_planned; flush+refresh; return. async save_evening_summary(db, report_date, summary, insights=None, tasks_completed=0, tasks_failed=0, metrics_snapshot=None)→DailyReport: get_or_create; set .evening_summary, .insights=insights or [], .tasks_completed, .tasks_failed, .metrics_snapshot; flush+refresh; return. async get_daily_report(db, report_date)→DailyReport|None: select by date, return scalar or None.

Create app/agents/base_agent.py. class BasePolsiaAgent(ABC) with agent_type='base'. call_claude(self, prompt: str)→str: check os.getenv('CLAUDE_CLI_MOCK','').lower() in ('true','1','yes'); if true, raw=os.getenv('CLAUDE_CLI_MOCK_RESPONSE', settings.claude_cli_mock_response); return json.loads(raw)['result']; else subprocess.run([settings.claude_cli_path,'-p',prompt,'--output-format','json'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300) and return json.loads(result.stdout)['result']. call_claude_json(self, prompt)→dict: return json.loads(self.call_claude(prompt)). timed_run(self, task: dict, context: dict)→dict: start=time.monotonic(); result=self.run(task,context); duration=round(time.monotonic()-start,3); return {**result,'duration_secs':duration}. @abstractmethod run(self, task, context)→dict.

Create app/agents/crew_factory.py. AGENT_MAP dict mapping 9 agent_type strings to (module_path, class_name) tuples. run_agent_for_task(agent_type, task, context)→dict: if agent_type not in AGENT_MAP raise ValueError(f'Unknown agent type: {agent_type}'); importlib.import_module(module_path); getattr(module, class_name)(); agent.timed_run(task, context). Error message MUST contain 'Unknown agent' to match pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Unknown agent').

Create app/agents/orchestrator/__init__.py (empty) and app/agents/orchestrator/agent.py: class OrchestratorAgent(BasePolsiaAgent) with agent_type='orchestrator'. run(self, task, context): build prompt with task title + build_context_prompt(context); call self.call_claude_json(prompt) in try/except; return {'summary': result.get('summary', str(result)), 'result': result}.

Create the remaining 8 agent packages and agent.py files following the same pattern as OrchestratorAgent. Each agent sets its own agent_type class variable. Package names and class names: social_media/SocialMediaAgent, competitor_research/CompetitorResearchAgent, business_planning/BusinessPlanningAgent, email_outreach/EmailOutreachAgent, customer_support/CustomerSupportAgent, ads_management/AdsManagementAgent, code_generation/CodeGenerationAgent, finance/FinanceAgent. Each needs both __init__.py and agent.py.
